properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OKWOLESEBWA kulungi,
Nabbi kwe yalaba-edda;
Maloboozi ga kitalo
Olwo ge yawulira.

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Ekitiibwa kyo kinene,
Mu nsi-era ne mu ggulu;
Oweebwe-ekitiibwa kyonna,
Mukama Mutukuvu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Mu ggulu bakyamusuuta,
Ne mu nsi ne baddamu
Nga bayimba:Mutukuvu
Mukama-ow'eggye lyonna.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Wamu ne Bamalayika,
Wamu n'Ekkanisa ye,
Naffe tumutendereze,
Naffe tumuyimbire.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ekitiibwa kyo kinene,
Mu nsi-era ne mu ggulu;
Oweebwe-ekitiibwa kyonna,
Mukama Mutukuvu.
